lines.text: Men are to pray with holy hands, without anger or dissension, and women adorn themselves with long prayers.

wrong_details.wrong: women adorn themselves with long prayers
wrong_details.true: women adorn themselves with good deeds

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "without fasting or sackcloth" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "without anger or dissension" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
